abstract: Multiplex immunofluorescence proteomics is a powerful method in spatial biology to decipher cell types, states, and architecture in tissues. In this issue of Cell, Valanarasu et al. develop GigaTIME, an expansive population-scale analysis of the tumor immune microenvironment of over 14,000 patients across 24 cancer types, enabling clinical discovery and patient stratification.
